query:
SELECT DISTINCT version_id,
            ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT l.loader) filter (where l.loader is not null) loaders
        FROM versions v
        INNER JOIN loaders_versions lv ON v.id = lv.version_id
        INNER JOIN loaders l ON lv.loader_id = l.id
        WHERE v.id = ANY($1)
        GROUP BY version_id
